title: Gemini CLI ran unapproved commands hidden behind an allowlisted one
summary: Gemini CLI read project context files as trusted input and matched shell commands against its allowlist by prefix, so an injected instruction could append a second command after an approved one and run it without a prompt. Tracebit reported it to Google on 27 June 2025 and a fix shipped in 0.1.14 on 25 July 2025.
severity_rationale: Silent command execution and data exfiltration triggered by nothing more than pointing the agent at an untrusted repository.
